SeatEditor.Name: Table Seats
SeatEditor.Label: Configure Seats
SeatEditor.Hint: Choose the table user and map characters to seats around the table screen.

SeatPicker.Name: Table seat
SeatPicker.Label: Choose your seat
SeatPicker.Hint: Choose where your character sits around the table screen.

HideCoreUI.Name: Hide standard Foundry UI on the table
HideCoreUI.Hint: Hides the sidebar, hotbar, player list, scene navigation, scene controls and chat pop-ups on the table screen. The seat panels replace them.

KeepSceneControls.Name: Keep scene controls visible
KeepSceneControls.Hint: Shows Foundry's left-hand toolbar on the table even when the standard UI is hidden. Usually not needed: the pill's Ruler button and the R key work while the toolbar is hidden.

RotateWindows.Name: Rotate windows toward the seat
RotateWindows.Hint: Windows opened from a seat (roll dialogs, spell-slot and rest dialogs, journals) are rotated and moved toward that player. A seated character's sheet, and its items' sheets, face that character's seat however they are opened (for example by double-clicking the token).

TurnIndicator.Name: Your-turn indicator
TurnIndicator.Hint: Highlights the seat of the character whose turn it is in combat.

ChatHistory.Name: Chat messages per seat
ChatHistory.Hint: How many recent chat messages each seat's chat panel shows.

PhysicalDice.Name: Physical dice
PhysicalDice.Hint: Roll real dice at the table and record the results in Foundry. The system then applies modifiers as usual. The table screen switches to physical dice automatically; other users can pick "Physical dice (Awesome VTT)" in Configure Dice.

Choices.both: The player or the GM (first entry counts)

DiceSoNice.Name: 3D dice for Foundry-rolled dice (Dice So Nice)
DiceSoNice.Hint: While physical dice are on, dice that Foundry rolls instead ("Let Foundry roll", or dice left empty) are shown as Dice So Nice 3D dice. Dice entered by hand follow Dice So Nice's "Disabled for manually entered rolls" setting. Needs Dice So Nice; has no effect without it.

UIScale.Name: Table UI scale
UIScale.Hint: Size of the seat panels on this screen. Adjust until the text is comfortable to read from a chair.

FoldPill.Name: Fold pill rows
FoldPill.Hint: Show only the character row of each pill. The map tools and the section buttons open below it when the pointer comes near the pill, and stay open while one of its panels is open.

IconOnlyButtons.Name: Icon-only pill buttons
IconOnlyButtons.Hint: Show only icons on the Sheet and Chat & Dice buttons of each character pill. The map tools are always icon-only. On narrow seats the labels are hidden automatically so the buttons stay on one line.

KeepAwake.Name: Keep the screen on
KeepAwake.Hint: Stops this screen from dimming or sleeping while the table is open. Needs HTTPS and a supporting browser.

IdleOpacity.Name: Idle pill opacity
IdleOpacity.Hint: How visible pills and the initiative strip are when the mouse is not over them. Lower values show more of the map. Open panels are always fully opaque.

UseChecks.Name: Check actions before use
UseChecks.Hint: When an action from a seat needs a target, a spell slot or uses that are missing, stop and say so in that seat, before any dialog opens.

AutoRoll.Name: Roll follow-up dice automatically
AutoRoll.Hint: After an attack roll, roll its damage (hit or miss; critical damage on a critical hit); after a saving-throw action, roll its damage; after a utility action, roll its formula, as the chat card's buttons would. Damage and healing actions already roll by themselves.

RollNotices.Name: Show roll results
RollNotices.Hint: Show the result of each roll made at the table (checks, saves, attacks, damage, healing, the dice pool) in the seat of the character who rolled it, with physical or Foundry dice, once Dice So Nice has finished. Pass or fail against a DC shows unless dnd5e hides challenge results from players; hit or miss shows if dnd5e shows attack results to players. Blind rolls are not shown. Click the notice to dismiss it.

AutoDeathSaves.Name: Prompt for death saves
AutoDeathSaves.Hint: At the start of a seated character's turn in combat, if they are at 0 HP and neither stable nor dead, ask for the death saving throw in their seat.

AutoConcentration.Name: Prompt for concentration checks
AutoConcentration.Hint: When a seated character who is concentrating takes damage, ask for the Constitution saving throw in their seat, with the DC dnd5e works out.

AutoSaves.Name: Prompt for saving throws
AutoSaves.Hint: When a spell or ability that calls for a saving throw targets a seated character, ask for the save in their seat, with its DC.

AutoRequests.Name: Prompt for GM requests
AutoRequests.Hint: When the GM requests a group rest, save or check (D&D 5e) or a challenge roll (Shadow of the Demon Lord) from a seated character, ask in their seat.

AskBoons.Name: Ask for boons and banes
AskBoons.Hint: Shadow of the Demon Lord: rolling an attribute from a seat's sheet first asks how many boons or banes the roll gets, preset to the seat's Next roll choice.

AutoInitiative.Name: Prompt for initiative
AutoInitiative.Hint: When a seated character is in the active encounter without initiative, ask in their seat (in Shadow of the Demon Lord: a fast or slow turn).

CloseOtherPanels.Name: Close other seats' panels
CloseOtherPanels.Hint: Opening a panel in one seat closes the panels open in the other seats.

SeatEditor.Title: Table Seats
SeatEditor.TableUserHint: The non-GM user logged in on the table screen. Seated characters are given Owner permission for this user; permissions are reverted when a seat is cleared.
SeatEditor.InvalidUser: The table user must be an existing non-GM user.

SeatMove.Title: Table seat
SeatMove.Hint: Choose where each of your characters sits around the table screen. Picking a taken seat swaps the two characters; a character that isn't seated yet can only take a free seat.
SeatMove.NoGM: A GM must be logged in to change seats.

Pill.MissingActor: This seat's character no longer exists.
Pill.NotOwner: The table user does not own this character. Re-save the seats as GM.
Pill.NoToken: This character has no token on the current scene.
Pill.RulerHint: Ruler tool not found. Press R to toggle the ruler.
Pill.LevelUpReady: Level up (enough XP for the next level)
Pill.FavoritesHint: Star actions or items in the sheet to add them here.

Chat.Placeholder: Message, or a command such as /r 1d20

Dice.Empty: Click dice to build a roll

Compendium.Placeholder: Search or browse items, spells, rules…
Compendium.TypeMore: Type at least 2 characters to search.

Initiative.Waiting: waiting for the GM to add combatants

Dice.Title: Enter your dice
Dice.WaitingForGM: Waiting for the GM to enter the results…
Dice.GMCanEnter: The GM can also enter these results.
Dice.EmptyIsDigital: Dice left empty are rolled by Foundry.
Dice.AllEntered: All dice of this type already have a result. Use Clear to change them.
Dice.Incomplete: Enter a valid result for every die.

Journal.External: This page type opens in the full journal.

Checks.NoTargetHint: {name}: press the Target button on your pill (hover over the pill to show it), then click the token. Click it again to untarget. Targets are cleared after each action.
Checks.NoSlotHint: {name} needs a level {level} slot or higher.

Quick.Title: Quick actions
Quick.NoEffects: Nothing to switch on or off right now. Effects such as Rage, Bladesong, or an item's or spell's toggleable effect appear here.
